Your attack with Masendan scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
If you expend 2 Ki Points or fewer when using Masendan, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Kamehameha
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 5 Ki Points to concentrate your Ki into a single point. and unleash a powerful, streaming beam of energy. The wave travels up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide.

Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Charged Kamehameha.} When you use Kamehameha, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy this turn.

On your next turn, you must use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to release the charged Kamehameha. When released, the streaming beam of energy travels up to 60 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 2 higher when calculating the attack's damage.

While charging Kamehameha, you must maintain Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. If you don't release the charged Kamehameha on your next turn or lose Concentration before releasing it, the gathered energy dissipates and the Ki Points expended are lost.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan
entries: {@i 6th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Ancient legends tell of a Saiyan warrior who could transcend the limits of their mortal body and awaken a power far beyond that of an ordinary Saiyan. When pushed beyond their limits by overwhelming adversity, a Saiyan may awaken this power, causing their hair to turn golden and their aura to blaze with radiant energy.
To awaken Super Saiyan, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 16 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 250 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, a creature you consider an ally must die within your line of sight.

After awakening Super Saiyan, you can expend 2 Ki Points to transform into a Super Saiyan without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by one die.
• Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptation Ki Art II
entries: {@i 6th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Full Power Masenko
entries: You gather an immense amount of Ki above your head, causing brilliant yellow energy to flare between your hands before bringing them forward and unleashing a vastly more powerful Masenko.
You can now expend up to 7 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 60 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 1 higher.
If you expend 3 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Super Explosive Wave
entries: You release a sudden burst of Ki from your entire body, creating a powerful shock wave that blasts away nearby enemies.

As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature you can see within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can expend up to 5 Ki Points to release an explosive wave of Ki. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw against your Ki save DC.

On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

items.name: Super Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery of the Kamehameha allows you to channel far greater amounts of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 7 Ki Points when using Kamehameha. and its normal range increases to 40 feet.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 80 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 3 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 2 higher.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan 2
entries: {@i 10th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

You are a Saiyan who has pushed the power of the Super Saiyan beyond its limits, awakening a form of even greater ferocity and destructive power. Your golden aura erupts with crackling lightning, your golden hair rises sharply, and your power intensifies to a terrifying degree.
To awaken Super Saiyan 2, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 18 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you and at least two of your allies must become Bloodied or be reduced to 0 hit points.
You can expend 4 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan 2 without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by two die.
• Your Speed increases by 20 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Cold, Force, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, and Thunder damage.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptation Ki Art III
entries: {@i 10th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Spirit Ball
entries: You concentrate Ki into your hand and form it into a dense sphere of energy that remains under your control after being released, allowing you to redirect it toward your target.

As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 10 Ki Points to create a Spirit Ball and launch it at one creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Make a Ki attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended .
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 2 higher when calculating the attack's damage
Your attack with Spirit Ball scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19 or 20.

If the attack misses, the Spirit Ball remains under your control until the end of your next turn. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your next turn, you can redirect the Spirit Ball toward the same creature or another creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself and repeat the attack without expending additional Ki Points. After this attack hits or misses, the Spirit Ball dissipates.
If you expend 5 Ki Points or fewer when using Spirit Ball, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

items.name: Explosive Demon Impact
entries: The an {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 7 Ki Points to surge toward one creature you can see within a distance up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the target.
Make two {@variantrule Unarmed Strikes|XPHB} against the target. These attacks must be kicks.
If both attacks hit, you can push the target up to 30 feet away from you.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

items.name: Electric Kamehameha
entries: You channel an incredible amount of Ki through your body, causing your golden aura to flash violently as you gather the energy into a brilliant golden-yellow Kamehameha. When released, the flashing energy surges forward with tremendous destructive force, creating an enormous explosion in its wake. You can now expend up to 10 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 50 feet.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 100 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 3 higher.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Ultimate
entries: {@i 14th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}
You have awakened the full extent of your dormant potential, allowing you to naturally wield tremendous power without placing immense strain on your body.
To awaken Ultimate, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan 2.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 20 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 1000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
{@b Ultimate Potential Ritual.} To fully unlock your potential, you must undergo a 24-hour ritual performed by a creature with the Spellcasting feature that can cast spells as Rituals.
After completing the Ultimate Potential Ritual, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls. and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
• The bonus to your Ki Damage from Unlock Potential increases from one die to two dice.
• The bonus to your Speed from Unlock Potential increases from 10 feet to 40 feet.
• The bonus to your Ki Point maximum from Unlock Potential increases from an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Ultimate Ki Art
entries: {@i 14th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Hyper Masenko
entries: You gather an overwhelming amount of Ki above your head, causing brilliant yellow energy to erupt between your hands before bringing them forward and unleashing a raging, vastly more powerful Masenko.

You can now expend up to 12 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 90 feet. For the purpose of calculating its damage, treat the number of Ki Points expended as 3 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 1 higher.
If you expend 6 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

items.name: Hyper Explosive Demon Wave
entries: Your mastery of Super Explosive Wave allows you to release a far greater burst of Ki, dramatically increasing its destructive power and range.
When you use Explosive Wave, you can expend up to 7 Ki Points instead of 5.
For the purpose of determining the damage of Explosive Wave, the number of Ki Points you expend is treated as 1 higher.
The range of Explosive Wave increases to 20 feet, and a creature that fails its saving throw is pushed up to 20 feet away from you instead of 10 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.
If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, its body is reduced to ash.

items.name: Ultimate Kamehameha
entries: You gather an immense amount of Ki into your cupped hands, concentrating it into a brilliant blue mass of energy before thrusting your arms forward and unleashing an enormous Kamehameha. With sufficient mastery, you can gather this tremendous power while standing perfectly still, only drawing your hands back at the final moment before releasing the devastating energy wave. You can now expend up to 12 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 60 feet.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 120 feet, no longer requires Concentration and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 5 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 4 higher.

You no longer need to use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

subclassFeature.name: Mastered Ultimate
entries: {@i 18th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Through relentless training and battle, you have mastered your Ultimate power, allowing you to draw upon your full potential naturally and without relying on Super Saiyan transformations. Your power now flows with complete control and efficiency, bringing your Ultimate state to its absolute peak.
To unlock Mastered Ultimate, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Ultimate.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 24 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 2500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• You must win a hostile encounter against a creature whose Challenge Rating is equal to or greater than your Saiyan level without transforming into Super Saiyan or any of its advanced forms.
After mastering Ultimate, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls, and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.
• The bonus to your Ki Damage from Ultimate increases from two dice to three dice.
• The bonus to your Speed from Ultimate increases from 40 feet to 70 feet.
• You can take two {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage except Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Ultimate Ki Art
entries: {@i 18th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Ultimate Masenko
entries: You gather an overwhelming amount of Ki above your head, compressing it into an intensely radiant mass of golden-yellow energy before thrusting your hands forward and unleashing the ultimate form of Masenko as a colossal beam of destructive power.

You can now expend up to 15 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 120 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 3 higher.
If you expend 7 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Thunder Bullet
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 15 Ki Points to charges a tiny energy sphere before firing at one creature you can see within 90 feet of yourself.
Make a Ki attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended.
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage
Your attack with Thunder Bullet scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 17, 18, 19, or 20.
If you expend 7 Ki Points or fewer when using Thunder Bullet, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Ultimate Explosive Kamehameha
entries: You concentrate an overwhelming amount of Ki into a brilliant blue Kamehameha, compressing tremendous power between your hands before releasing it as a colossal wave of energy. With sufficient mastery, the technique requires almost no preparation, allowing you to remain perfectly still until the final moment before unleashing its full power in a devastating surge. You can now expend up to 15 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 90 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 180 feet in a line that is 15 feet wide, no longer requires Concentration and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 6 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 5 higher.

You no longer need to use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast
entries: {@i 20th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Beast is the ultimate evolution of your awakened potential, born from the power that has continued to grow within you throughout your life. When overwhelming emotion finally pushes that potential beyond its limits, your Ultimate power erupts into a new transformation of tremendous raw power and speed, surpassing everything you were previously capable of.
To unlock Beast, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Mastered Ultimate.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 30 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 5000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you must see a creature you consider a loved one or family member be reduced to 0 Hit Points or die.
You can expend 12 Ki Point to transform into a Beast without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls, and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 15-20.
• Your Ki Damage increases by three dies.
• Your Speed increases by 120 feet.
• You have Advantage all saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.
• Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier.

• When a creature you can see misses you with an attack, you can immediately move up to half your Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one melee weapon attack or one Unarmed Strike against it.

• When an attack roll would hit you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to dodge the attack, causing it to miss you instead. You can then immediately take one additional {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, which must be used to make an attack against the attacking creature or use a Ki Art that targets it.

• Once on each of your turns when you score a Critical Hit, you regain 1 expended Ki Point and can immediately use one of your Ki Arts that normally requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} without using a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Ki Art
entries: {@i 20th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}
You can use these Beast Ki Art only while transformed into Beast.

items.name: Special Beam Cannon
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend any Ki Points to concentrate an immense amount of Ki at your forehead before extending your fingers and unleashing a devastating beam of spiraling energy.

The beam travels up to 300 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ki save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 10 higher when calculating the attack's damage
If you expend 10 Ki Points or fewer when using Beast Special Beam Cannon, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Purple Lightning Beast Kick
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 10 Ki Points to surge toward one creature you can see within a distance up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the target.

You leap forward and deliver a sudden kick to the target. This {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} automatically hits and is a Critical Hit, the target takes additional Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended.

When the kick hits, you can push the target up to 60 feet away from you. If the target collides with a wall, another obstacle, or another creature during this movement, the target and the creature it collides with each take Force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Racial
entries: You are a Saiyan, an alien warrior race with tremendous physical potential. When you choose this class, you don't choose a separate race for your character — the traits below replace your race entirely.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid (Saiyan).

entries.name: Age
entries: Saiyans stay in their physical prime much longer than humans to maintain their combat strength, maintaining a youthful appearance until about age 80 before aging rapidly. Their natural total lifespan is roughly similar to a human.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Saiyans tend to share common personality traits, even at young ages. Being aggressively militant, they share an innate enjoyment for conflict and fighting. Saiyans are typically very aggressive and hard-headed, with short explosive tempers. Saiyans appear inclined to be arrogant at times, They are typically chaotic natured.

entries.name: Size
entries: Saiyans are Medium or Small, your choice.

entries.name: Saiyan Speed
entries: Saiyans possess tremendous levels of superhuman speed, easily capable of breaking the sound barrier, even with their basic moves. They also have much faster reflexes than an average human
Your base walking speed is 50 feet.

entries.name: Saiyan Strength
entries: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 30. Additionally

entries.name: Saiyan Endurance
entries: Saiyans possess enormous amounts of superhuman durability and are a remarkably resilient species who refuse to be physically broken.
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item shield|xphb}, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|xphb} equals 10 plus your Strength and Constitution modifiers.

entries.name: Saiyan Power
entries: Saiyans naturally possess vast superhuman strength, far greater than that of Earthlings and other alien races and are veritable fighting machines. They are capable of easily lifting ten times their own weight.
You count as two sizes larger than your actual size when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage.

entries.name: Ki Sensing
entries: Saiyans instinctively sense the ki around them. You gain Blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Tail
entries: All pure-blooded Saiyans are born with a brown-furred, monkey-like tail. The tail is prehensile and can grasp and hold objects weighing up to one-tenth of your carrying capacity, though it can't wield weapons or perform tasks requiring fine manipulation.

As long as you still have your tail, gazing directly upon a full moon triggers an uncontrollable transformation. At the start of your turn, if you can see a full moon and haven't averted your eyes or otherwise avoided its light, you transform into a Great Ape, using the statistics of the {@creature Giant Ape|MM |}.

While transformed, you retain your personality, alignment, and mental ability scores, but you lose the ability to speak, cast spells, or take any action other than Attack, Dash, or Grapple. On each of your turns, you must move toward the creature nearest to you and attack it, friend or foe alike, to the best of your ability.

The transformation ends immediately if your tail is severed, if the moon sets, or if the moon is blocked from your view for the duration of a full turn. When the transformation ends, you revert to your normal form, and your tail (if still attached) is unharmed.

entries.name: Heat Resistance
entries: Your Saiyan biology grants you exceptional resistance to extreme heat. You are unaffected by the effects of extreme heat, and you have Resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and know Common Sign.

classFeature.name: Zenkai
entries: Every 10 minute, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you have at least 1 Hit Point. While you are in combat, this power awakens, and you instead regain twice that amount at the start of each of your turns.

Whenever you regain Hit Points after taking damage from a hostile creature in combat, you gain a number of Zenkai Points equal to the number of Hit Points regained. You can expend Zenkai Points to increase one of your ability scores by 1, at a cost equal to 10 times the new score.
In addition, you can spend Zenkai Points to permanently increase your Ki Damage by one die. The cost equals 1,000 Zenkai Points multiplied by the number of Ki Damage dice you currently have.

classFeature.name: Ki Points
entries: Saiyans have a natural affinity to control ki energy, allowing them to generate very powerful energy blasts
You have a number of ki points, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Saiyan table. You regain all expended ki points when you finish a short or long rest.
Starting at 1st level, you can use these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing none of these features; you gain them as you reach higher levels in this class.
Your Ki save DC equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier.
Your Ki attack modifier equals your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts I
entries: You can manipulate your Ki to create a variety of energy-based techniques, using your natural Saiyan affinity and martial arts mastery to enhance your combat abilities.

items: {@b Power Full Strike.} At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Ki Point to empower your body with Ki. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit with an melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Flight.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 10 minute.

{@b Ki Transfer.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to transfer your Ki to another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the target hits with a melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Ki Charged.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you focus your energy and begin gathering Ki. You regain a number of Ki Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries: You can use Ki Charged a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Telepathy
entries: You know the {@spell Message|XPHB} cantrip. In addition, you can cast the {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot by touching the head of a creature. You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood
entries: At 1st level, you choose a Saiyan Blood, detailed at the end of this class description. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 3rd, 6th, 10th, 14th, 18th and 20th level.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts II
entries: You learn to shape your Ki into powerful blasts and defensive barriers, allowing you to attack from a distance and protect yourself from harm.

items: {@b Ki Wave. } As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 +  your Proficiency Bonus, to fire waves of ki in a straight line. The waves travel up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, a creature takes no damage.

{@b Ki Blast. } As an {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 +  your Proficiency Bonus, to fire concentrated blasts of Ki. For each Ki Point expended, You fire one blast at a creature within 60 feet of you. Each blast deals Force damage equal to your Ki Damage on a hit.

{@b Ki Shield. } As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take damage, you can expend 2 Ki Point to surround yourself with a barrier of Ki. The damage you take is reduced by half, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Ki Damage.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can push your body beyond its limits, causing your aura to flare crimson. The transformation lasts for 1 minute. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You can take one additional attack on each of your turns.
• Your Speed is doubled.
• Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
When the transformation ends, your body suffers extreme recoil. You become Incapacitated for 1 round and take damage equal to half your current Hit Points.
You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 3rd level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x2
entries: At 5th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×2. While transformed, you can make two additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to twice your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ki Recovery
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed the ability to rapidly restore its Ki.
At the end of each of your turns, you regain 1 Ki Point. At 10th level, you instead regain 2 Ki Points. At 15th level, you instead regain 3 Ki Points. At 20th level, you instead regain 4 Ki Points.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Instinct
entries: Your Saiyan instincts sharpen your awareness, allowing you to react to danger before combat begins.
You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and add your Proficiency Bonus to those rolls. In addition, you can't be Surprised while you are conscious.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Fortitude
entries: Your Saiyan body can withstand forces that would overwhelm ordinary creatures. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half as much damage on a successful save, you can make a Constitution saving throw instead.
On a successful save, you take no damage from the effect. On a failed save, you take half damage instead.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Spirit
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Saiyan level. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.
You can use this feature twice before a Long Rest starting at level 13 and three times before a Long Rest starting at level 17.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 10th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x10
entries: At 11th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×10. While transformed, you can make three additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to three time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Resilience
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed extraordinary resilience through countless battles.
Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier + your Strength modifier.
In addition, the Hit Points you regain from your Saiyan Blood are doubled.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 14th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: KI Mastery
entries: You have perfect ki control. The Ki Point cost to transform and maintain a Saiyan Transformation is reduced by half, rounded down.
While you have the Bloodied condition, this feature does not activate.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x20
entries: At 17th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×20. While transformed, you can make four additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to four time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@feat Epic Boon|XPHB} or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Limit Break
entries: Each of your ability scores increases by 2.
Your ability scores no longer have a maximum.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 20th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.
